reader_review.progression: U04 limits -> secant definition -> family rules -> product/quotient -> chain/layers -> implicit/second rates -> independent checks and cumulative synthesis. Unit introduction gives purpose/prerequisites; each lesson reconnects without reintroducing the unit. Conclusion returns to instantaneous rate and prepares U06/U07.

5.1–5.2.skills: Definition, quotient algebra, tangent, reciprocal domain
5.1–5.2.comparison: Active Calculus1.1 Activities1.1.2–1.1.3 average/instantaneous velocity; OpenStax3.1 definition examples. Our tasks require exact general-input algebra after supported lesson work, not a finite table alone.

5.3.skills: Continuity versus differentiability and one-sided quotients
5.3.comparison: OpenStax3.2 absolute-value/corner discussion. Original shifted-corner explanation, no new prerequisite.

5.4.skills: Power, reciprocal/root, exponential/log including bases, trig including tangent, boundaries/radians
5.4.comparison: OU MST224 U1 Exercises26–27 pp41–42 standard derivatives. Our set expands domain/boundary judgement and delays mixed-rule work to subsequent questions.

5.5–5.7.skills: Product and quotient; original domain after cancellation
5.5–5.7.comparison: OU Example3 p43 and Exercise29(a–b)p44, OpenStax3.3 product/quotient examples. More explicit error diagnosis and hole distinction; logarithm chain prerequisites separated.

5.8–5.9.skills: Layer identification, nested chains and mixed rules
5.8–5.9.comparison: OU Exercises30–31p45; Active Calculus2.5 Examples2.5.1–2.5.3 and PreviewActivity2.5.1. Comparable method families, different functions and added domain/first-rule explanations. OU assumes previous calculus; ours builds it.

5.10.skills: Radian chain factor, first/second rates and units
5.10.comparison: OU Exercise29(d)p44 second-rate calculation and §3.1p24 radian convention. Original supplied sinusoidal displacement separates unit conversion and phase; no dynamics theory required.

5.11–5.12.skills: Implicit tangent, point membership, second derivative, exceptional point
5.11–5.12.comparison: OU implicit ellipsep45/Exercise32p46; OpenStax3.8 Examples3.69–3.70. Our first task includes product term; second adds explicit independent check and vertical-tangent interpretation.

5.13.comparison: OU Exercises25/27pp41–42 and29(d)p44; original zero-velocity/nonzero-acceleration diagnostic with units.

5.14.skills: Choose parameters for differentiability, diagnose missing second derivative
5.14.comparison: OpenStax3.2 differentiable piecewise example/checkpoint3.8. Original synthesis adds second-order failure; taught polynomial branch assumptions retained.

5.15–5.16.skills: Error diagnosis, counterexample, choice of numerical tests
5.15–5.16.comparison: Original audit tasks calibrated to the taught rules and ActiveCalculus1.1 evidence/limit distinction. No exact supplied OU programming comparator. Expected written explanations, not merely corrected answers.

5.17.skills: Select alternative routes, prove equivalence, differentiate again
5.17.comparison: OU Exercise31p45 mixed methods and OpenStax3.3 simplification/quotient discussion. Original two-route requirement increases independence after scaffolding fades.

5.18.skills: Physical chain, second rate, units, model limits and exact cross-check
5.18.comparison: Active Calculus2.5 chain-as-rate reasoning; original sensor synthesis grounded in L04 calibration example. No matching OU sensor exercise claimed.
